Name: Raptor - Deinonychus LOOSE FILES for Adopt n' Skin
Author: Greenblyat
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24306349]Zynonia's[b] [/b]Velociraptor mod[/url], a male Deinonychus. Classic coloration and even 4 different .wav sounds to choose from! Just a tilesheet, so this requires Content Patcher or Adopt n' Skin. Made to replace dinosaurs/lizards. If you would like to use this for chickens or other small animals, you must make a copy for the babies otherwise it won't work. 

-Tail swishing
-Bouncing feathers
-With or without movement sprites!

﻿png. and wav. only!
[b]

Install with Adopt n' Skin![/b]
Simply drag into either a custom folder or /assets/skins and rename to Dinosaur_1 or whichever number you'd like as long as it doesn't replace your own skins

[b]Easy Dinosaur Sound Replacement![/b]
I was able to replace only Dinosaur sounds by replacing the "Yee" wav. with your choice. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8422]"Yee" Dinosaur mod. [/url]Requires Content Patcher and Custom Music.
